datasets.name: a1b2c3d4
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    service_date,
    line_sign,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    planned_service_hours,
    missed_service_windows,
    avg_planned_headway_minutes,
    avg_headway_deviation_minutes
  FROM main.gold.gold_terminal_risk_daily
  WHERE (
      :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
      OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
      OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                          AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      :p_line_sign = 'ALL'
      OR line_sign = :p_line_sign
    )
    AND (
      :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
      OR CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
    )
  GROUP BY
    service_date,
    line_sign,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    planned_service_hours,
    missed_service_windows,
    avg_planned_headway_minutes,
    avg_headway_deviation_minutes
)
SELECT
  MAX(service_date) AS latest_service_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT line_sign) AS affected_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('_', line_sign, CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING))) AS affected_line_directions,
  SUM(planned_service_hours) AS planned_service_hours,
  SUM(missed_service_windows) AS missed_service_windows,
  AVG(avg_planned_headway_minutes) AS avg_planned_headway_minutes,
  AVG(avg_headway_deviation_minutes) AS avg_headway_deviation_minutes
FROM base

datasets.name: b2c3d4e5
queryLines:
WITH period_base AS (
  SELECT
    line_sign,
    route_id,
    route_long_name,
    route_name_display,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    direction_description,
    trip_headsign_reference AS trip_headsign,
    terminal_role,
    stop_id,
    stop_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    service_date,
    planned_service_hours,
    observed_service_hours,
    missed_service_windows,
    avg_planned_headway_minutes,
    avg_headway_deviation_minutes
  FROM main.gold.gold_terminal_risk_daily
  WHERE (
      :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
      OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
      OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                          AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
    )
    AND (
      :p_line_sign = 'ALL'
      OR line_sign = :p_line_sign
    )
    AND (
      :p_gtfs_direction_id = 'ALL'
      OR CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) = :p_gtfs_direction_id
    )
    AND (
      :p_terminal_role = 'ALL'
      OR terminal_role = :p_terminal_role
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    line_sign,
    route_id,
    route_long_name,
    route_name_display,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    direction_description,
    trip_headsign,
    terminal_role,
    stop_id,
    stop_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service_date) AS affected_service_days,
    SUM(planned_service_hours) AS planned_service_hours,
    SUM(observed_service_hours) AS observed_service_hours,
    SUM(missed_service_windows) AS missed_service_windows,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(planned_service_hours) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(missed_service_windows) * 1.0 / SUM(planned_service_hours)
    END AS missed_service_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(planned_service_hours) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(COALESCE(avg_planned_headway_minutes, 0.0) * planned_service_hours) * 1.0 / SUM(planned_service_hours)
    END AS avg_planned_headway_minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(planned_service_hours) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(COALESCE(avg_headway_deviation_minutes, 0.0) * planned_service_hours) * 1.0 / SUM(planned_service_hours)
    END AS avg_headway_deviation_minutes
  FROM period_base
  GROUP BY
    line_sign,
    route_id,
    route_long_name,
    route_name_display,
    gtfs_direction_id,
    direction_description,
    trip_headsign,
    terminal_role,
    stop_id,
    stop_name,
    latitude,
    longitude
)
SELECT
  latitude,
  longitude,
  line_sign,
  route_long_name,
  gtfs_direction_id,
  trip_headsign,
  terminal_role,
  stop_id,
  stop_name,
  affected_service_days,
  planned_service_hours,
  missed_service_windows,
  missed_service_rate,
  avg_planned_headway_minutes,
  avg_headway_deviation_minutes,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(missed_service_rate, 0) >= 0.40 OR COALESCE(avg_headway_deviation_minutes, 0) >= 10 THEN 'High'
    WHEN COALESCE(missed_service_rate, 0) >= 0.15 OR COALESCE(avg_headway_deviation_minutes, 0) >= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS terminal_risk_band
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY missed_service_windows DESC, line_sign ASC, terminal_role ASC

datasets.name: d4e5f607
queryLines:
SELECT
  line_sign
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS line_sign, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT line_sign AS line_sign, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM main.gold.gold_terminal_risk_daily
  WHERE (
      :p_service_date_range.min IS NULL
      OR :p_service_date_range.max IS NULL
      OR service_date BETWEEN CAST(:p_service_date_range.min AS DATE)
                          AND CAST(:p_service_date_range.max AS DATE)
    )
    AND line_sign IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(line_sign) <> ''
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, line_sign

datasets.name: e5f60718
queryLines:
SELECT
  gtfs_direction_id
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS gtfs_direction_id, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(gtfs_direction_id AS STRING) AS gtfs_direction_id, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM main.gold.gold_terminal_risk_daily
  WHERE gtfs_direction_id IS NOT NULL
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, gtfs_direction_id

datasets.name: f6071829
queryLines:
SELECT
  terminal_role
FROM (
  SELECT 'ALL' AS terminal_role, 0 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ORIGIN' AS terminal_role, 1 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'DESTINATION' AS terminal_role, 2 AS sort_order
) options
ORDER BY sort_order, terminal_role
